why.en: Bangladesh football's worst ASEAN Cup loss: Indonesia 9-2. Massive shock, covered by multiple outlets.

why.en: Remittances jump 13% this quarter. Strong economic signal, trending with investment interest on Google.

why.en: 252 women and girls faced violence in September. Serious social issue, consistent reporting concern.
